judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and four failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`. It never actually implemented the feature in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or added `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, all the newly added tests will fail, leaving the test suite broken. Furthermore, it completely missed the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts`, and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
